newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Paul Harris EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Paul Harris EPS view raised.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it raised its FY98 earnings per share estimate on Paul Harris Stores Inc by $0.03 to $1.20 as a result of a reduction in the retailer's interest expense.

--It noted that Paul Harris on Wednesday announced the retirement of the remaining $14.7 million in debt associated with the company's emergence from bankruptcy in 1992. The debt had an interest rate of 11-3/8 percent.
--Rodman also reiterated its buy rating and 12-month price target of $30.
